description: Land Acquisition - Devadeniya, Laggala D/S Division, Matale District
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition for the Moragahakanda & Kaluganga Development Project. It provides detailed descriptions of specific land parcels being acquired, including lot numbers, land names, descriptions, claimants, possessors/cultivators, and exact measurements. The notice is issued under the Land Acquisition Act and deals with property ownership transfers for a public purpose, which falls squarely under the Land Gazette classification (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
